subject: Invalidating downstream only if return value of a reactive expession changes

messages.author: b77c540835bb3b48
messages.subject: Invalidating downstream only if return value of a reactive expession changes
parts:
Hi,

I am writing a Shiny application where some long-running reactive computations depend on a data-frame that itself is the result of a reactive expression.

I would like the long-running computations to be triggered only if the *actual values* in the data-frame change, which might not always be the case (there can be changes in the inputs that do not trigger a change in the value of the data-frame).

I found that if the data-frame is returned from a reactive expression then downstream calculations are triggered once the reactive expression is invalidated, irrespective of whether the actual value returned by the reactive expression has changed. However, if I store it into a reactiveValue and subsequent calculations reference the reactiveValue object, then those are only triggered upon actual value change.

I prefer keeping everything a reactive expression and minimize the usage of reactiveValues if possible, so I was wondering if there was a way of using reactive expressions and still trigger downstream invalidation only if the actual value returned by the reactive expression changes.

Below is a minimal example that reproduces this behavior, when changing the input, only the reactive expression is re-triggered as shown by the console output:

```
library(shiny)
ui <- fluidPage(
  
  title = 'reactive() vs reactiveValue()',

 sliderInput("test","Test",1,10,1),
  h3("The below numbers will not change:"),
  textOutput("test_1"),
  textOutput("test_2")
)

server <- shinyServer(
  function(input, output,session) {
    constant_val <- reactiveValues(val=1)
    
    observeEvent({input$test},
                 constant_val$val <- input$test^0)
    
    output$test_1 = renderText({
            print('re-running expensive computation with reactiveValue...')
            constant_val$val
    })
    
    constant_val2 <- reactive({
      input$test^0
    })
    
    output$test_2 = renderText({
      print('re-running expensive computation with reactive()...')
      constant_val2()
    })
})


shinyApp(ui,server)
```

Thank you very much for the help and apologies if this question has already been answered, I could not find any relevant references online.

Best regards,

Andras
